mapper.insert: MERGE INTO PROFILE_IMG p USING (SELECT #{profilePath} AS PROFILE_PATH, #{profileOriginalName} AS PROFILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, #{profileRename} AS PROFILE_RENAME, #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO FROM DUAL) s ON (p.MEMBER_NO = s.MEMBER_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.PROFILE_PATH = s.PROFILE_PATH, p.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_NAME = s.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, p.PROFILE_RENAME = s.PROFILE_RENAME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(PROFILE_NO, PROFILE_PATH, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, PROFILE_RENAME, MEMBER_NO) VALUES(SEQ_PROFILE_NO.NEXTVAL, s.PROFILE_PATH, s.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_NAME, s.PROFILE_RENAME, s.MEMBER_NO)
